top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 90 RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 28 were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found 90 FEC RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 28, and every one was already reported in a prior edition, so there are no new RFAIs, Form 99 letters, terminations or voided and negative transactions to report in this edition.
No red-flag keyword hits turned up, and the fetch reported no errors or gaps.

sections.headline: $108,759 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 2 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $108,759 in all. Largest target: Brian Poindexter (oppose, $108,759).

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/28/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 28, 2026 through October 31, 2026 (Pacific), PM edition. 90 filings in the window, all previously reported.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
